snippet.title: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is coming soon ⏳#CellarCleanupSimulator #cozygames #indiegame #WishlistNow
snippet.description:
🍷 Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing organization simulator where you place hundreds of bottles scattered across a mysterious cellar onto their rightful shelves. Your goal is to restore this legendary collection to its former glory and prove that you are a true cellar master.

Turn chaos into a flawless collection.

🍷 Organize bottles 
📚 Upgrade your skills 
🥂 Strike a balance between power and control

🚨 However, it won't be as easy as you think… Because every sip comes with a price.

Drinking from the cellar's special reserves will allow you to use your abilities. But as your alcohol level rises, controlling your character will become increasingly difficult.

More power? Or more control? The choice is yours.

On top of that, the physics-based carrying system will make things even trickier. Every bottle you drop or break will prevent you from completing the cellar flawlessly.

Check out the bio to add it to your Wishlist
